title: snmCAT V2 Protocol for Nuclei Isolation and cDNA Amplification
author: Bang-An Wang
materials: Prepare the stock solutions for nuclei isolation, stored at 4 °C : 10X Diluent buffer : Tris-Cl pH 8.0 (120 mM), KCl (150 mM), MgCl2(30 mM) NIB: Tris-Cl pH 8.0 (10 mM), KCl (25 mM), MgCl2 (5 mM), Sucrose (250 mM)

Prepare the following solutions freshly before each experiment: NIB_plus On ice : NIB + DTT (1 mM) + Proteinase inhibitor (0.5X) + SUPERase• In ( 1:1000 dilution) + RNaseOUT ( 1:1000 dilution) NIBT On ice : NIB_plus + 0.1% Triton X-100 50% Iodixanol Room temperature : 5 vol. Optiprep (60% Iodixanol) + 1 vol. Dilutent 25% Iodixanol Room temperature : 1 vol. 50% Iodixanol + 1 vol. NIB DPBS + RNase inhibitor On ice : DPBS + SUPERase• In ( 1:1000 dilution) + RNaseOUT ( 1:1000 dilution)
Proceed to the snmC-seq2 library preparation protocol. https://www.protocols.io/view/methyl-c-sequencing-of-single-cell-nuclei-snmc-seq-pjvdkn6

steps.title: Pre-chill Equipment and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and reagents for nuclei isolation on ice.

substeps.instruction: Plunge Dounce and Pestles on ice in a 50ml tube.
Transfer 3ml of NIBT buffer to the Dounce and chill on ice for 10 min.
Pre-chill 2 ml and 5 ml low retention microcentrifuge tubes on ice.
Cool the swing bucket rotor to 4°C.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei via Douncing and Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Extract nuclei from tissue samples using a Dounce homogenizer and Iodixanol gradient.

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissue sample or pre-ground tissue powder into the Dounce containing 3 ml of NIBT.
Gently dounce 40 times with a loose pestle (A) and 40 times with a tight pestle (B), avoiding bubbles.
Mix the suspension with 2 ml of 50% Iodixanol by pipetting in a 5ml ice-cold microcentrifuge tube.
Aliquot 500 µl of 25% Iodixanol cushion into 2 ml low retention microcentrifuge tubes and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 5 min to sharpen the interface.
Slowly pipette 1ml of cell mixture onto the 500 µl 25% Iodixanol cushion (repeat for 5 tubes total).
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 20 min at 4°C using a swing rotor.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of ice-cold DPBS + RNase Inhibitors.
Add Hoechst 33342 and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Immunolabel Nuclei
steps.instruction: Apply specific antibodies to the isolated nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 900 µl of DPBS + RNase inhibitors and 100 µl UltraPure BSA (50 mg/ml).
Add specific amount of nucleus antibodies (e.g., 1 µl AlexaFluor 488 conjugated anti-NeuN clone A60 for mouse/human neurons) and incubate on ice for 20 min.

steps.title: Perform NOMe Treatment
steps.instruction: Execute two cycles of GpC Methyltransferase (NOMe) reaction.

substeps.instruction: Count nuclei using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Transfer < 1 million nuclei per reaction to a new tube, centrifuge at 1000 x g for 10 min at 4°C, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 50 µL DPBS.
Perform 1st cycle NOMe reaction: Mix 50 µl Nuclei mix, 15 µl GpC Methyltransferase Buffer (10X), 0.15 µl S-adenosylmethionine (SAM 32mM), 15 µl GpC MTase, and 70 µl H2O. Incubate at 37°C for 8 mins.

Perform 2nd cycle NOMe reaction: Mix 150 µl 1st GpC treated nuclei mixture, 15 µl GpC Methyltransferase Buffer (10X), 0.15 µl S-adenosylmethionine (SAM 32mM), 15 µl GpC MTase, and 120 µl H2O. Incubate at 37°C for 8 mins.
Stop the reaction with 1ml ice-cold DPBS and centrifuge at 1000 x g for 10min at 4°C.

steps.title: Filter and Prepare for Sorting
steps.instruction: Clean and filter the nuclei before FACS.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1ml DPBS + RNase inhibitors.
Filter through a 40 um Cell strainer.

steps.title: Prepare and Distribute mCT Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reverse transcription mix and distribute to 384-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mCT master mix per reaction: 0.2 µl 5X First-Strand Buffer, 0.05 µl 0.1M DTT, 0.1 µl 1% Triton X-100, 0.1 µl 25mM MgCl2, 0.06 µl 500mM NaCl2, 0.05 µl 5-methyl-dNTP (10mM), 0.012 µl dT30VN_5 (100 μM), 0.02 µl N6_3 (100 μM), 0.05 µl TSO_4 (48 μM), 0.025 µl RNaseOUT (40U/μl), 0.025 µl SUPERaseIn (20U/μl), 0.05 µl Superscript II RT, and 0.258 µl H2O (Total 1 µl).
Note: For high RNA abundance, RNaseOUT, SUPERaseIn, and Superscript II RT can be reduced to 0.01 µl per reaction.
Use Beckman i7 robot to add 1 µL RT mix into each well of a 384 well plate.
Quick centrifuge the plates and keep on ice.

steps.title: Sort Single Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate single nuclei into the prepared plates.

substeps.instruction: Sort single nuclei using BD Influx or other sorters into 384 well plates on one-drop single mode.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates in a thermocycler using the following program:

substeps.instruction: 25°C for 5 mins (1x)
42°C for 90 mins (1x)
50°C for 2 mins (10x)
42°C for 2 mins (1x)
85°C for 5 mins (1x)
4°C hold

steps.title: Amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Prepare amplification mix and perform PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cDNA amplification mix per reaction: 0.8 µl KAPA2G Buffer A (5X), 0.024 µl ISPCR23_3 (100 μM), 0.016 µl KAPA2G Robust HotStart DNA Polymerase (5 U/μL), and 2.16 µl H2O (Total 3 µl).
Add 3 µL of this mix into each well of the 384 well plate.

Incubate in a thermocycler for the optimized number of cycles based on cell type: Mouse/human neuronal (11-13), Mouse/human non-neuronal (13-15), P120 Mouse non-neuronal (15), P120 Mouse neuronal (11), Human culture fibroblast/induced neurons (11-13), Human H1/HEK293 whole cell (11), Human H1/HEK293 nuclei (11-13).

steps.title: Perform Uracil Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest uracil in the amplified cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL RT mix into each well of a 384 well plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 mins.
Add 25 µL Zymo direct bisulfite conversion reagent into each well of a 384 well plate.
Incubate with a thermocycler.
